title: Meeting of the Academic Council of BSU

blocks.text: On April 16, 2025, a meeting of the Academic Council was held at Bishkek State University. The agenda included important issues related to the educational process, admission campaign and scientific activities.
The heads of the relevant departments made presentations:
– Tadjibaeva T.R. presented the results of the winter examination session of the 2024–2025 academic year;
– Botokanova G. T. reported on the results of admission of students and postgraduates to the 1st year;
– Tologonova M. T. covered issues of scientific work, advanced training of teaching staff and admission to postgraduate studies.

In the "Miscellaneous" section, competitive elections for the positions of heads of departments were held. Candidates for a number of faculties were approved, which helps strengthen the university's human resources potential.
The meeting was productive and outlined key guidelines in the development of educational and scientific activities at BSU.
